fusions.name: Raking Tine
fusions.desc: A rake that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterwards. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Tail Flagged
fusions.desc: You bound up to 6 tiles to the target. The rush deals 25 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone at the Snap
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Startled Into Flight
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
